title: Hostinger coupon SONAR20: 20% off, where to enter the code and what it covers

description: The Hostinger coupon SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period, on a monthly or annual plan, for new or existing customers. See where to paste the code and what changes at renewal.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Yes, there is a coupon: the code **SONAR20** gives 20% off the first period of any [Hostinger](/en/coupons/hostinger) plan, monthly or annual, for new or existing customers. Paste the code in the coupon field of the cart, or follow the link in this article. The 20% also apply on renewal.

contentSections.heading: What SONAR20 covers
paragraphs: Under the partnership rules, SONAR20 is valid on all plans, monthly and annual, and also for people who are already Hostinger customers. We tested it in the cart: with the code in the “Have a coupon code?” field on the global site, the 48-month Startup plan went from US$383.52 to US$306.82. In the test, the 20% came off the Black Friday price, and the code worked on its own, without the link.
This article's link still works, with its own rules: plans of 12 months or more, for new customers. In other cases, use the code. We do not mention codes from other sites.

contentSections.heading: Where to paste the code
paragraphs: Choose the plan and the period and go to the cart. In the order summary, click “Have a coupon code?”, paste **SONAR20** and apply it. The 20% discount shows up in the first-period total before you pay. The code is also on the [Hostinger page here on the site](/en/coupons/hostinger).

contentSections.heading: This site runs on Hostinger
paragraphs: Em Casa com Cecília runs on Hostinger, and Bruno has been a customer since 2024, with more than 24 months of subscription. He uses Business hosting, a KVM 2 VPS, Business email and domains, all with automatic renewal. Every time he had a problem, support solved it, mainly through the AI agent. Personally, he has never seen the service go down. That is his experience.

contentSections.heading: Monthly plan, annual plan and existing customers
paragraphs: SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period on a monthly or annual plan, for new or existing customers. The code works on VPS and WordPress plans and on renewal, but on a standalone domain it does not work. For email and AI agents, check in the cart whether the discount shows up. Existing customers use the code on a new plan, and it also works on the renewal of a plan you already have; check the price in the dashboard.

contentSections.heading: Renewal: what changes after the first period
paragraphs: After the first period, the plan renews at the standard price, shown below each plan's card. The page says you can change the period or cancel at any time before renewal.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
bullets: Choose the plan and the period and go to the cart.
Paste SONAR20 in the coupon field and apply it.
Check that the 20% shows up in the first-period total and that the renewal is listed.
If the cart total differs from the prices on the page, the cart total is the one that counts.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Hostinger have a coupon? Yes: the code SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period of any plan, monthly or annual.
Where do I enter the Hostinger coupon? In the cart, in the “Have a coupon code?” field. Paste SONAR20 and apply it before paying.
Does SONAR20 work for existing customers? Yes, on a new plan, under the partnership rules, and on the renewal of a plan you already have; check the price in the dashboard.
Does the coupon discount the renewal? Yes, the code works on renewal. Check the renewal price in the cart before paying.
Does SONAR20 work on Black Friday? Yes: in the cart test, the 20% came off the campaign price.
